gradeDescription: A = I excelled at everything I did today!
noteworthyComments: Today I worked on my place command! We practiced building excitement and engagement for going to my mat, then worked on staying there calmly. I had lots of fun learning that my place is a great spot to be before enjoying the rest of my day with my friends! My favourite part of the day was playing with toys and getting my friends to chase me around the yard !
